Article separates billing tokens ('computed after all processing') from the rate-limit estimate that is calculated at admission time; using billing totals as the counter is the wrong mental model.

Fixed-minute-boundary synchronization ignores the short-window RPM check (Azure OpenAI evaluates over 1- or 10-second intervals) and keeps the inflated estimate; the docs recommend jittered exponential backoff instead.

rubric.notes: Advanced troubleshooting scenario that forces the candidate to distinguish estimate vs billing tokens and burst RPM vs one-minute averages. Distractors reflect real anti-patterns (over-reservation, retry storms, minute-boundary retry). Reasoning depth is genuine, not wordiness.

Fidelity is 'How well the top n retrieved chunks reflect ... the known good documents' — quantity alone is not relevance.

rubric.notes: Expert troubleshooting question that layers retrieval tuning, qrels sanity, and system-evaluation separation. Distractors capture real evaluation mistakes.
